regions.today: A mainly dry and warm evening with sunny spells. Cloudier towards the south in light to moderate winds.
regions.tonight: Turning cloudy overnight but staying mostly dry overall. Lows of 14 to 17 degrees in moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Quite cloudy tomorrow with occasional showery rain, possibly heavy in the afternoon. Some sunshine breaking through at times. Less warm and humid than previous days with highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees with moderate to fresh southerly winds.
